comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Network security firewalls and security subscriptions for enterprise IT, not IoT connectivity hardware or remote device management.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Enterprise IoT connectivity, routers/gateways and cloud connectivity management sold to device makers and enterprises, closely overlapping Digi's offering.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Fleet telematics and asset tracking SaaS for vehicles; an application solution rather than general IoT connectivity infrastructure.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: CAD and PLM engineering software for manufacturers; no connectivity hardware, only a small industrial IoT software piece.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Carrier voice and optical networking equipment (session border controllers) sold to telecom providers, not edge IoT connectivity.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Rugged mobile computers, barcode scanners and printers for enterprise data capture, a different product category from IoT connectivity.
